# Extended regexes (grep -E), one per line, matched against each changed file path.
# If EVERY file in a merge group matches, the merge queue skips the integration tests.
# Read from the base branch, so a queued PR cannot change its own skip list.
\.md$
^docs/
^LICENSE
^\.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/
^\.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE
^\.github/CODEOWNERS$
